summary: Publishes messages and data payloads to a WebSocket channel/topic from a client Cables patch.

ports.name: Client Connection
ports.text: The Client Connection object from Ops.Local.Standalone.WebSocketClient.

ports.name: Channel
ports.text: Name of the channel/topic to publish this message to.

ports.name: Data
ports.text: The payload (object, array, string, number) to publish.

ports.name: Target Client ID
ports.text: Optional specific client ID for direct unicast messaging.

ports.name: Send to All Clients
ports.text: Broadcasts this message to all connected clients.

ports.name: Send to All Channels
ports.text: Broadcasts this message across all channels/topics.

ports.name: Retain
ports.text: If true, requests the broker to retain this message for new subscribers.

ports.name: On Published
ports.text: Fires when the message is sent over the WebSocket connection.

ports.name: Success
ports.text: True if the message was successfully dispatched.
